description.value: Quickly fading numbers and vague images help highlight the calculating nature of an ironic character on an otherwise dangerous battlefield. When you @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.actions.Item.o8lqmFexiwcaLpu3]{Set the Spotlight} on yourself, you can @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.actions.Item.ttL2TstfSqOyzCd2]{Cast a Role} to apply the irony role to yourself as a free action. As long as you are in the spotlight with the irony role, you can use Performance to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo] on any creature whom you've already assigned the irony role (even if they are not currently in the spotlight).
